In [[general relativity]], '''geodesic''' is a trajectory of a free-falling object in curved [[spacetime]].

== Properties ==

=== $d(A,B)=[A,B]$ ===

where $[A,B]$ is a segment of a '''geodesic''' between points $A,B$ in [[spacetime]] and $d$ is the [[metric space#Formal_definition|metric function]]. 

<blockquote>
Intuitively, this means that the shortest distance in [[spacetime]] between two points is the length of the geodesic segment between them.
</blockquote>
